One keyboard and mouse across your Windows PCs, with a shared clipboard for text, images
and files. Download **HomeKVM.exe** below and run it on each PC. It starts in the tray;
click the tray icon to open it, then pair your PCs with the 6-digit code.

**Not code-signed yet.** Windows SmartScreen will show "Windows protected your PC" the
first time: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Because the app shares the keyboard
and mouse with global input hooks, antivirus software may also flag it until it's signed.
Free signing through SignPath Foundation is planned.

Windows may ask to allow HomeKVM through the firewall. Allow it on **private** networks so
your PCs can find each other.

See the [README](https://github.com/saugatadatta/HomeKVM#readme) for what's in this version.
